ayahs.1: Yaqeenan Allah Taala ne us aurat ki baat suni jo tujh se apne shohar ke baare mein takraar kar rahi thi aur Allah ke aage shikayat kar rahi thi, Allah Taala tum dono ke sawaal-o-jawaab sun raha tha, beshak Allah Taala sunne dekhne wala hai.
ayahs.2: Tum mein se jo log apni biwiyon se zihaar karte hain (yaani unhein maan keh baithte hain) woh dar-asal un ki maayen nahin ban jaatin, un ki maayen to wahi hain jin ke batan se woh paida hue, yaqeenan yeh log ek na-maqool aur jhooti baat kehte hain. Beshak Allah Taala maaf karne wala aur bakhshne wala hai.
ayahs.3: Jo log apni biwiyon se zihaar karen phir apni kahi hui baat se rujoo kar len to un ke zimma aapas mein ek doosre ko haath lagaane se pehle ek ghulam aazaad karna hai, is ke zariye tum naseehat kiye jaate ho. Aur Allah Taala tumhare tamaam aamaal se ba-khabar hai.
ayahs.4: Haan jo shakhs na paaye us ke zimma do maheenon ke lagaataar roze hain is se pehle ke ek doosre ko haath lagaayen aur jis shakhs ko yeh taaqat bhi na ho us par saath miskeenon ka khaana khilaana hai. Yeh is liye ke tum Allah ki aur us ke Rasool ki hukm-bardaari karo, yeh Allah Taala ki muqarrar karda haden hain aur kuffaar hi ke liye dardnaak azaab hai.
ayahs.5: Beshak jo log Allah aur us ke Rasool ki mukhalifat karte hain woh zaleel kiye jaayenge jaise un se pehle ke log zaleel kiye gaye the, aur beshak hum waazeh aayaten utaar chuke hain aur kaafiron ke liye to zillat wala azaab hai.
ayahs.6: Jis din Allah Taala un sab ko uthaayega phir unhein un ke kiye hue amal se aagaah karega, jise Allah ne shumaar rakha hai aur jise yeh bhool gaye the, aur Allah Taala har cheez se waaqif hai.
ayahs.7: Kya tu ne nahin dekha ke Allah aasmanon ki aur zameen ki har cheez se waaqif hai. Teen aadmiyon ki sargoshi nahin hoti magar Allah un ka chautha hota hai aur na paanch ki magar un ka chhata woh hota hai aur na is se kam ki aur na ziyaada ki magar woh saath hi hota hai jahaan bhi woh hon, phir qayamat ke din unhein un ke aamaal se aagaah karega beshak Allah Taala har cheez se waaqif hai.
ayahs.8: Kya tu ne un logon ko nahin dekha? Jinhein kaana-phoosee se rok diya gaya tha woh phir bhi is roke hue kaam ko dobaara karte hain aur aapas mein gunaah ki aur zulm-o-ziyaadati ki aur naafarmaanee-e-Paighambar ki sargoshiyan karte hain, aur jab tere paas aate hain to tujhe un lafzon mein salaam karte hain jin lafzon mein Allah Taala ne nahin kaha aur apne dil mein kehte hain ke Allah Taala hamein is par jo hum kehte hain saza kyun nahin deta, un ke liye jahannam kaafi (saza) hai jis mein yeh jaayenge, so woh bura thikaana hai.
ayahs.9: Ae imaan walo! Tum jab sargoshi karo to yeh sargoshiyan gunaah aur zulm (ziyaadati) aur naafarmaanee-e-Paighambar ki na hon, balke neki aur parhezgaari ki baaton par sargoshi karo aur us Allah se darte raho jis ke paas tum sab jama kiye jaaoge.
ayahs.10: (Buri) sargoshiyan, pas shaitaani kaam hai jis se imaan-daaron ko ranj pahunche. Go Allah Taala ki ijaazat ke baghair woh unhein koi nuqsaan nahin pahuncha sakta. Aur imaan walon ko chaahiye ke Allah hi par bharosa rakhen.
ayahs.11: Ae Musalmano! Jab tum se kaha jaaye ke majlison mein zara kushadgi paida karo to tum jagah kushada kar do Allah tumhein kushadgi dega, aur jab kaha jaaye ke uth khade ho jaao to tum uth khade ho jaao Allah Taala tum mein se un logon ke jo imaan laaye hain aur jo ilm diye gaye hain darje buland kar dega, aur Allah Taala (har is kaam se) jo tum kar rahe ho (khoob) khabardaar hai.
ayahs.12: Ae Musalmano! Jab tum Rasool (sallallahu alaihi wasallam) se sargoshi karna chaaho to apni sargoshi se pehle kuch sadqa de diya karo yeh tumhare haq mein behtar aur paakeeza-tar hai, haan agar na paao to beshak Allah Taala bakhshne wala mehrbaan hai.
ayahs.13: Kya tum apni sargoshi se pehle sadqa nikaalne se dar gaye? Pas jab tum ne yeh na kiya aur Allah Taala ne bhi tumhein maaf farma diya to ab (ba-khoobi) namazon ko qaayam rakho zakat dete raha karo aur Allah Taala ki aur us ke Rasool ki taabedaari karte raho. Tum jo kuch karte ho is (sab) se Allah (khoob) khabardaar hai.
ayahs.14: Kya tu ne un logon ko nahin dekha? Jinhon ne us qaum se dosti ki jin par Allah ghazabnaak ho chuka hai, na yeh (munaafiq) tumhare hi hain na un ke hain baa-wujood ilm ke phir bhi jhoot par qasmen kha rahe hain.
ayahs.15: Allah Taala ne un ke liye sakht azaab taiyaar kar rakha hai, tahqeeq jo kuch yeh kar rahe hain bura kar rahe hain.
ayahs.16: Un logon ne to apni qasmon ko dhaal bana rakha hai aur logon ko Allah ki raah se rokte hain un ke liye ruswa karne wala azaab hai.
ayahs.17: Un ke maal aur un ki aulaad Allah ke haan kuch kaam na aayengi. Yeh to jahannami hain hamesha hi is mein rahenge.
ayahs.18: Jis din Allah Taala un sab ko utha khada karega to yeh jis tarah tumhare saamne qasmen khaate hain (Allah Taala) ke saamne bhi qasmen khaane lagenge aur samjhenge ke woh bhi kisi (daleel) par hain, yaqeen maano ke beshak wahi jhoote hain.
ayahs.19: Un par shaitaan ne ghalba haasil kar liya hai, aur unhein Allah ka zikr bhula diya hai yeh shaitaani lashkar hai. Koi shak nahin ke shaitaani lashkar hi khasare wala hai.
ayahs.20: Beshak Allah Taala ki aur us ke Rasool ki jo log mukhalifat karte hain wahi log sab se ziyaada zaleelon mein hain.
ayahs.21: Allah Taala likh chuka hai ke beshak main aur mere Paighambar ghaalib rahenge. Yaqeenan Allah Taala zor-aawar aur ghaalib hai.
ayahs.22: Allah Taala par aur qayamat ke din par imaan rakhne walon ko aap Allah aur us ke Rasool ki mukhalifat karne walon se muhabbat rakhte hue hargiz na paayenge go woh un ke baap ya un ke bete ya un ke bhai ya un ke kunba (qabeele) ke (azeez) hi kyun na hon. Yahi log hain jin ke dilon mein Allah Taala ne imaan ko likh diya hai aur jin ki taaeed apni rooh se ki hai aur jinhein un jannaton mein daakhil karega jin ke neeche nehren beh rahi hain jahaan yeh hamesha rahenge, Allah un se raazi hai aur yeh Allah se khush hain yahi log Allah ka giroh hain, aagaah raho! Beshak Allah ka giroh hi kaamyaab hone wala hai.
